_comment: Copy to calendars.json, which is gitignored, and fill in. list_calendars prints each id; a made calendar's id ends in @group.calendar.google.com. The operator makes both calendars by hand in the Calendar web UI (Settings, Add calendar, Create new calendar), because the connector cannot create one.

confirmed.name: [CLAUDE] Confirmed
confirmed.holds: booked calls and anything confirmed only by email

event_color_ids._comment: null means the calendar's own color. The event API takes colorId 1 to 11 only.
